article_title: Poundland hopeful for last-minute rescue deal to stave off collapse

tasks.prompt: What is the central development in the report about Poundland?
options: A release of £10m may delay collapse while a rescue deal is sought
The chain has already closed all 600 stores
Tesco has completed a takeover of Poundland
Poundland has repaid all of its creditors
tasks.correct_answer: A release of £10m may delay collapse while a rescue deal is sought
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מדווחת ששחרור של 10 מיליון ליש״ט עשוי לדחות את הקריסה ולאפשר זמן למציאת עסקת הצלה.

tasks.prompt: Why had Poundland been moving towards administration?
options: Christmas sales were cancelled
Its 10-day moratorium had already ended
Its owners blocked access to money in its bank accounts
All potential buyers withdrew their interest
tasks.correct_answer: Its owners blocked access to money in its bank accounts
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הכתבה, הבעלים חסמו את גישת החברה לכספים בחשבונותיה, ולכן היא התקשתה לשלם ולהצטייד.

tasks.prompt: How many employees does Poundland have, according to the report?
options: About 600
About 11,000
About 18,100
About 50,000
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בפתיחת הכתבה מצוין שלפאונדלנד כ־11,000 עובדים.

tasks.prompt: What does “stave off collapse” mean in the headline?
options: Sell the company in separate pieces
Close stores before Christmas
Report a larger annual profit
Delay or prevent the company from failing
tasks.correct_answer: Delay or prevent the company from failing
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי stave off פירושו לדחות או למנוע דבר שלילי; כאן מדובר בדחיית קריסת החברה.

tasks.prompt: What is Gordon Brothers accused of trying to do?
options: Profit by selling Poundland's stores and stock piecemeal
Convert every shop into a supermarket
Give all 600 stores to Poundland employees
Increase the price of Poundland products before Christmas
tasks.correct_answer: Profit by selling Poundland's stores and stock piecemeal
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הטענה היא שהבעלים מקווים להרוויח ממכירת החנויות והמלאי בחלקים; חברת ההשקעות מכחישה זאת.

tasks.prompt: In this report, what does a “moratorium” protect Poundland from temporarily?
options: Competition from other discount chains
A fall in Christmas sales
Action by its creditors
Questions from Members of Parliament
tasks.explanation_hebrew: moratorium הוא עיכוב זמני של הליכים; כאן מדובר בהגנה בת עשרה ימים מפני נושי החברה.

tasks.prompt: Why could the release of £10m help Poundland even though sources called it small in the scale of things?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שהכסף מספק זמן ונזילות זמניים, אך אינו בהכרח פתרון ארוך טווח.
expected_points: The money could help the company meet immediate needs and postpone collapse
The delay could provide time to negotiate a solvent rescue deal
The released amount is only part of roughly £50m that had been frozen

tasks.prompt: Summarise the disagreement between Poundland's management and Gordon Brothers about the chain's condition.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג את נתוני ההתאוששות של ההנהלה מול הערכת הסיכון של הבעלים.
expected_points: Management said the business made an £18.1m profit after a previous £68m loss
Gordon Brothers described the chain as challenged and vulnerable to a downturn

tasks.prompt: Why is the timing before the Christmas trading period especially important for Poundland?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשר בין מחסור במזומן, מילוי מדפים, שכר ושכירות לבין תקופת מסחר חשובה.
expected_points: The chain needs cash to restock its 600 shops
It must also pay wages and rent
Christmas is a crucial trading period, so empty shelves or disruption could damage recovery prospects

tasks.prompt: Write a short paragraph explaining the two competing options for Poundland and how each might affect jobs.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להשוות בין קונה שישמור על הרשת הלאומית לבין מכירה בחלקים, ולהתייחס להשפעה האפשרית על תעסוקה.
expected_points: One option is a buyer keeping Poundland together as a national chain
Another is selling stores and stock in separate chunks
Interest from Poundstretcher, Tesco and B&M could preserve some store jobs
The key uncertainty is which option would protect more of the 11,000 employees
